messages:
sarah: heads-up — after yesterday's shard-affinity RBAC rollout some customers reported cross-workspace reads. reproducing now, sharing notes below.

raj: on it. which deployment/time?

sarah: v3.2.7, deployed ~2024-11-01T02:10Z. change was the project->workspace inheritance refactor (shard-affinity). behaviour looks like some workspace-scoped roles are being evaluated at shard scope.

ingrid: can you paste the audit snippet? @audits-bot any hits?

audits-bot: found 3 events matching session id abc123 across orgs org-A and org-B (metadata access). sample:```
{"ts":"2024-11-01T02:17:33Z","actor":"svc-embedder-42","org":"org-A","workspace":"ws-7","action":"workspace.list_items","detail":"list call returned 18 items"}
{"ts":"2024-11-01T02:18:01Z","actor":"svc-embedder-42","org":"org-B","workspace":"ws-2","action":"workspace.list_items","detail":"list call returned 22 items"}```

tom: hmm. if svc token used in two workspaces that's bad. sounds like `namespace_affinity` or role-scope resolution changed. are we rolling back?

sarah: started canary rollback on shard-9. unsure if existing sessions will be revoked automatically. recommend rotating any service-account keys minted between 02:00-03:00 UTC.

raj: quick triage Q: were any KMS bindings changed as part of the deploy? if unwrap fallback allowed shard-level decrypts that could explain cross-org reads.

ingrid: checked KMS logs — no cross-key unwraps. unwraps are org-scoped and show only expected principals. this looks like access decision service issue, not KMS.

sec-bot: suggested mitigations:
1) disable `shard-affinity` feature flag immediately
2) apply an emergency deny policy at shard scope for `workspace:access`
3) rotate tokens for service-accounts created 02:00-03:00 UTC

sarah: commands i'm running to enumerate affected rows:```
SELECT org_id, workspace_id, actor, action, created_ts
FROM audit.events
WHERE created_ts BETWEEN '2024-11-01T02:00:00Z' AND '2024-11-01T03:00:00Z'
AND action LIKE 'workspace.%';```

and here's the small policy snippet suspected to be the culprit:```
{
  "role": "workspace.reader",
  "scope": "shard:shard-9",
  "inherits": true
}
```

tom: that `scope: shard:shard-9` with inherits=true would accidentally grant workspace reader to everything on that shard if precedence changed.

sarah: i'm seeing 4 orgs touched, ~12 workspaces. no evidence of secrets/KMS unwraps or bucket reads. mostly metadata and inference job lists. still treat as P1 for now.

ingrid: opening incident INC-2024-321 and adding affected orgs. link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2024-321

audits-bot: created incident annotations and flagged 12 events as high-risk.

raj: remediation plan: rollback -> run permission_sweeper job to emit revoke tasks -> force session revocation for affected service accounts -> run end-to-end smoke reg tests for role precedence. i'll take owner.

sarah: thanks. i'll handle customer comms for impacted accounts and coordinate key rotations as needed. also adding safety net: add an integration test asserting "workspace-scoped role precedence over shard-scoped roles".

tom: i'll draft the postmortem template + timeline once we have full scope.

ingrid: follow-ups assigned: raj -> remediation + sweeper, sarah -> customer comms + rotations, tom -> postmortem, ingrid -> incident owner + audit verification.

sarah: :thumbsup: pls ping if revoke fails or KMS logs show anything new.
